newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW denies U.K. report it may be sold.
newsitem.headline: BMW denies U.K. report it may be sold.

text.p: BMW AG on Thursday denied a published report saying that the German carmaker may soon be put up for sale by its major shareholder, the Quandt family, which owns about 50 percent.
"We deny this report," a BMW spokesman told Reuters in response to an enquiry.
The U.K. monthly "Car" magazine said in its September edition that rumours have begun to circulate in Germany that the Quandt family was preparing to sell its stake.
The report said secret talks were under way and that the two top contenders were Chrysler Corp of the United States and Japanese carmaker Toyota Motor Corp.
BMW officials said the report was pure speculation and that the Quandt family committed to the group.
